data.description: Phase A of docs/agent-exact-resume-plan.md. Exact-session resume for opencode via its plugin push rail. (1) reserved keys opencode.session_id (grammar ^ses_[0-9A-Za-z]{26}$ base62 — NOT the WIP Crockford regex, which rejects valid ids) + opencode.session_project_dir in WorkspaceMetadataKeys.swift + SurfaceMetadataStore.validateReservedKey; (2) skills/opencode-plugins/c11-notify.js session.created handler -> c11 conversation push --kind opencode --id <ses_> --source hook --state alive --cwd <dir>; (3) replace placeholder OpencodeStrategy: resume cd '<dir>' && opencode --dangerously-skip-permissions -s '<id>', transcriptExists via SQLite stat, isValidId base62; (4) port OpencodeScraper (SQLite, fixed grammar) as crash-recovery fallback; register in StrategyRegistry.v1 + flip manifest hasConversationStrategy. Port/fix from branch feat/opencode-resume. Acceptance: c11-logic green; live opencode quit+relaunch resumes the exact ses_ session. Independent.

data.body: Code-review: own-reviewer fallback executed — the headless 'lattice code-review' exited 0 but produced a vacuous artifact ('Diff is empty') because it resolved the diff range against LATTICE_ROOT (main checkout on 'main'), not the worktree branch. NOTE: row 1 (load-bearing) still pending — needs an OBSERVED live opencode quit+relaunch exact-session resume in a tagged build before pr_open, not just green units.

MV BLOCKER (pre-PR, actionable): C11-151's branch now CONFLICTS with origin/main after C11-152 merged (#273 → e6edf9513). I ran merge-tree: the ONLY conflicting file is GhosttyTabs.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj — every .swift/.js file auto-merges cleanly. Both branches added new Swift files to the project, and since C11-152 merged first, C11-151's pbxproj entries collide. This is the documented xcodeproj-gem pitfall (it reorders/normalizes on save). When this PR opens it will be UN-MERGEABLE and auto-merge will silently block. FIX before/at PR-open: rebase onto current origin/main and re-resolve pbxproj by taking main's project.pbxproj and re-adding C11-151's two files (Sources/Conversation/Scrapers/OpencodeScraper.swift + c11Tests/OpencodeResumeTests.swift, correct targets: app + c11Tests) via the xcodeproj gem — do NOT hand-merge the conflict markers (error-prone). Then re-verify xcodebuild -list + ref-count symmetry and re-run c11-logic.

✅ COMPLETE → pr_open. PR #274 (https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/274), 2 commits off main (2068d63ff feature + 6d5bd0ddc state-verify oracle).

Phase A delivered: reserved keys (base62), plugin session.created push handler (root-only), real OpencodeStrategy (cd-prefixed `opencode -s <id>`, base62 isValidId, three-valued transcriptExists), OpencodeScraper (read-only SQLite), state verify oracle extended.

Plan-review: PASS (folded R1 plugin-reinstall precondition + corrected resume to bare `opencode -s` since --dangerously-skip-permissions is run-only).
Code-review: own-reviewer fallback (headless CLI produced a vacuous empty-diff artifact — resolved diff against LATTICE_ROOT main checkout, not the worktree branch). PASS, no Critical/Major.

- 26 c11-logic tests green (incl. I/L/O/U base62 regression guard + real-SQLite scraper).
- Live: opencode session ses_0ef1b49a5ffePvUOJN5jYpSdAM (contains U/O — Crockford would reject) captured via plugin (source=hook) → snapshot → quit+relaunch → opencode RE-ATTACHED to the exact session with prior history visible; restore ran SQLite transcriptExists ("transcript verified on disk"); state verify prints the exact `cd '...' && opencode -s '<id>'`.
- Caveat (honest): session.time_updated did not advance — OpenRouter model out of credits blocked a new turn; resume proven by history + conversation-store ref, not the timestamp.

Stopping at pr_open per the delegator contract. Orchestrator to auto-merge (squash) + lattice complete. Did NOT merge myself.
